meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 提供 Figma 文件链接后,它会抓取这份设计稿的页面、组件、设计令牌等数据,生成一张可交互的设计知识图谱,并自动打开仪表盘。未设置 FIGMA_TOKEN 时会先提醒你配置。
howto.when: 当你让它分析某个 Figma 文件并附上链接或文件 key 时触发;也可以加 --language 指定分析说明的语言。缺 FIGMA_TOKEN 时它会先停下让你配置。

say.text: 用 --language zh 解析这个 Figma key:abc123
say.note: 分析说明会以中文输出。

say.text: 帮我梳理这个 Figma 链接里的页面和组件,做一张知识图谱
say.note: 会按页面分组并标注组件关系。

howto.what_en: When given a Figma file link, it fetches that design's data (pages, components, design tokens, etc.), builds an interactive design knowledge graph, and launches its dashboard. If FIGMA_TOKEN is not set, it stops and asks you to configure one first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze or understand a Figma file and give a link or key; pass --language <lang> to specify output language. If FIGMA_TOKEN is missing, it stops and asks you to set it.

say_en.note: Fetches the file and builds the design knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Parse Figma key abc123 with --language zh
say_en.note: Analysis notes will be generated in Chinese.

say_en.text: Map the pages and components in this Figma link into a knowledge graph
say_en.note: Groups by page and notes component relationships.
